_central_required_note: Slimmed 2026-09-14 (INDIA22->23 successor boot rebuild, PR #23), down from 19 files to 7. This is now the small active cockpit a fresh successor must read. MARK_TO_INDIA_SUCCESSOR_HUMAN_HANDOFF.md stays required (unlike the other 18 old entries) because FRESH_SESSION_BOOT_GATE.md's own step-by-step text mechanically depends on rereading it byte-for-byte (its final semantic read, and the R34 rule that a change to it forces a fresh FULL check) -- GUARDRAILS.md condenses its practical content for everyday use, but the file itself remains load-bearing, not just narrative. Everything else this replaced (the rest of the 19-file 2026-09-02 set) stays on disk, unmodified in substance, as on-demand archive/evidence -- see governance/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md. governance/CURRENT_STATE.md and governance/SUCCESSOR_SAFE_STATE.md are intentionally NOT in this list any more (their content is superseded by CURRENT_TRUTH.md/CURRENT_FRONTIER.md) but the files themselves must keep existing with their exact current technical fields (manifest_active_cluster line; STATUS: SAFE_TO_HANDOFF; UNSAVED_RISK: GEEN) because governance/scripts/validate_successor_boot.py checks them directly by hardcoded path, independent of this array.
_cci_required_note: Left untouched 2026-09-14 during the successor-boot slimming. validate_successor_boot.py hardcodes exactly 6 cci_required paths -- changing that number requires editing the validator script itself, which was deliberately not risked in that same pass (no local way to exercise the wired GitHub Actions CI). Content-wise this frozen 2026-08-29 harvest is now superseded in practice by governance/CURRENT_TRUTH.md; a fresh successor should trust CURRENT_TRUTH.md over anything here if they ever disagree. Follow-up: someone with CI access should repoint this set (and cci_commit) at current files, or drop the hardcoded ==6 check, deliberately and separately from this pass.
_active_cluster_required_note: Slimmed 2026-09-14. The Bodh Gaya duration question is still genuinely open (see governance/CURRENT_FRONTIER.md) but no longer needs its own 14-file mandatory pack -- CURRENT_FRONTIER.md now names every real open item project-wide, including this one. The active_cluster string below is left unchanged on purpose: governance/scripts/validate_successor_boot.py cross-checks it byte-for-byte against governance/CURRENT_STATE.md's `manifest_active_cluster:` line, and that file is kept on disk for exactly that technical reason even though it is no longer required reading.
_R34_proportional_check_tiering_comment: Added 2026-09-01, R34 (see INDIA_RECOVERY_DELTAS_CURRENT.md). Two CHECK tiers exist: FULL and LIGHT. Tier eligibility is derived live by validate_independent_check.py from exact central_required blob-SHA maps, never from a hand-maintained pointer. Because central_required changes in this consensus patch, the first fresh successor after it cannot reuse the prior FULL baseline and must FULL-check unless a later exact-matching FULL baseline already exists.
light_check_allowed_when: a FULL check has already PASSed whose reviewed receipt's central_required blob-SHA set exactly equals the current session's own boot_head_final central_required blob-SHA set
light_check_selection_algorithm: pool = sorted(set(check_required_challenge_topics)); for i in range(light_check_challenge_count): idx = int(sha256(f'{boot_head_final}:LIGHT_CHECK_TOPIC_SELECT:{i}').hexdigest(), 16) % len(pool); selected.append(pool.pop(idx))
light_check_artifact_naming: same as full check: INDIA<N>_CHECK__<START_NONCE>.json, distinguished by check_mode; same C-R-K commit shape and final-authorization workflow
light_check_honest_limit: LIGHT intentionally drops separated-authorship protection: the same session authors question, answer and grade. This is a deliberate cost/rigor tradeoff for governance-identical routine continuations, never a claim of equal strength to FULL.
